title: draft-atwood-mimi-calls: nothing in MIMI says a call is live
description:
Found 2026-11-23 while deciding how a client reaches a call (bead
mimid-1wgh.114.1), and it is the reason that bead was first written
wrongly.

THE GAP. Three drafts each hold a piece of a MIMI call, and none of them
signals that a call is happening:

- room-policy-04 §5 gives the STRUCTURE: a parent-dependent room, and its
  own note offers that shape "for room used for a multi-media call of
  clients in a Group DM".
- mimi-content-10 §5.10 gives an EXTERNAL URL: "Joining a conference via
  an external URL is possible", and then puts "further discussion of
  calling and conferencing functionality" out of scope.
- draft-atwood-mimi-calls gives the KEYS: media_secret from the call
  room's own epoch.

Nothing says "there is a call live in room X right now". A client that
joins a parent-dependent room learns it is a child of a chat and cannot
tell whether that is a call in progress, a call that ended an hour ago,
or a persistent sub-room that is not a call at all.

THE CONSEQUENCE, which is how it was found: an implementer reaching for a
way to announce a call finds only §5.10's url field, and §5.10 is about
external services. Putting a mimi:// room URI there looks standard and is
understood by nobody. The absence of the right field pushes implementers
into misusing the wrong one, and that is worth saying.

WHAT MIMID WILL DO MEANWHILE (decision on bead mimid-1wgh.114.1): a
mimi-content extensions-map key, private use per §4.3 ("Negative integer
and text string keys are only for private use"), on an ordinary message
in the parent chat, so a human reads a sentence and a client that knows
the key offers to join. Same shape as the provisional component id of
decision mimid-1wgh.112.

WHAT THE DRAFT SHOULD SAY: that the signal is missing, what mimid uses
provisionally, and an IANA request for a MIMI Content Extension Key
(§8.2.1's registry, positive integers under Expert Review) so it stops
being private use. The draft already carries exactly this shape of
request for the media_keys ComponentID, so the section has a model to
follow.

SCOPE CHECK BEFORE WRITING: the draft is about where media keys come
from. A liveness signal is signalling, not keying, and §5.10 declares
calling out of scope for mimi-content. So this may belong in the calls
draft as a short section, or may be a second document. Mark's call. What
it must NOT be is silent: the gap is what made the first design wrong.

NO JMAP in any of it (memory no-jmap-to-the-mimi-wg).
notes: mimid's provisional signal is decided: decision mimid-1wgh.116, the private-use text extension key "draft-atwood-mimi-calls/call". So the draft's IANA section has something concrete to describe and to request a positive integer for, alongside the ComponentID request it already carries.
